## Canonical surfaces (councilof.ai is the public site)
- [Council of AI](https://councilof.ai): the canonical public site
- [Signed scoreboard](https://councilof.ai/gspc-scoreboard)
- [Verify](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify): free, loginless, client-side
- [Arena](https://councilof.ai/gspc-arena): measured AI-vs-AI spectator
- [Measure](https://councilof.ai/measure): get measured
- [GSPC API](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc): live axis register (cite totals.public_count from this endpoint)
- [MCP](https://councilof.ai/mcp): Model Context Protocol integration
- [OS](https://councilof.ai/os): open-source resources

## Trust root (csoai.org — do not redirect these)
- [DID](https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json): the trust root (Ed25519) — did:web:csoai.org
- [Agent card](https://csoai.org/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A card
- [MCP discovery](https://csoai.org/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server discovery
- [MCP registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io): io.github.CSOAI-ORG/gspc

## How to verify (no login)
1. Fetch a signed artifact (receipt / board / card).
2. Recreate the content_id (RFC 8785 canonical JSON → SHA-256).
3. Verify Ed25519 against the public key in did:web:csoai.org.

## Honesty rules
- Measurement, not certification. Never a conformity mark.
- Cite live totals.public_count from GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc — never freeze axis counts.
- Legacy internal codenames are not public chrome; historical counts in old caches are superseded by the signed manifest.
